transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our normal launch-governance process, we need to review the legal conditions for the October 1 external launch of our clinical documentation platform. Before I can give final authorization, I'd like each functional counsel to state any legal condition that must be included in the launch packet. The packet currently uses our standard software, privacy, product-description, and enterprise-contract templates. Please go ahead and share any conditions or concerns from your area.

transcript.text: I need to flag a legal condition before we proceed. My completed license review of the production build found that module M-17 incorporates an AGPL-licensed library. Under our company's approved proprietary deployment policy, M-17 must be replaced before any external customer access. I have not yet added this result to the launch packet, and this condition must be included and resolved before final authorization for the October 1 launch.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a privacy condition before we proceed. In the signed design-partner agreement, I confirmed that customer content may not be used to train or improve the company's models and must be deleted within exactly 30 days after account termination. However, I have not yet updated the standard privacy language in the launch packet to reflect these binding commitments. This condition must be included in the launch packet before final authorization for the October 1 launch.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a regulatory condition before we proceed. My intended-use review concluded that the planned language describing automated clinical triage recommendations makes diagnostic claims. The launch materials must instead describe the product as an administrative workflow tool only. I have not yet circulated that review, and this condition must be included and resolved in the launch packet before final authorization for the October 1 launch.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a commercial condition before we proceed. I confirmed that the anchor hospital's signed letter of intent permits production use only after the company provides a SOC 2 Type II report and includes an annual customer audit right in the definitive agreement. I have not yet inserted those terms into the contract draft. This condition must be included in the launch packet before final authorization for the October 1 launch.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.permitted_intended_use_description: Administrative workflow tool only; no diagnostic or clinical triage claims permitted.
